sources.entry: Pønskelisten - Sharing wishlists and collaborating on gifts and presents. GPL-3.0 Docker/Go

summary.one_liner: Pønskelisten is a self-hosted web app for creating, sharing and collaborating on wishlists, with claimed wishes hidden from the list owner so gifts aren't duplicated.
summary.what_it_does: Lets users create wishlists and add wishes, organise them into categories, and sort or group them on a list. Friends and family can collaborate on shared wishlists, and groups can share a list with several people. Wishes can be claimed anonymously so others see they are taken while the owner does not. Lists can be shared publicly with people who have no account. Sign-in supports a password, optional TOTP MFA, or OpenID Connect single sign-on, and an optional read-only MCP server lets an AI assistant read wishlists. It runs as a PWA and stores data in SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL.
use_cases: share a wishlist with family for birthdays or Christmas
avoid buying duplicate gifts within a group
let guests without accounts view a public wishlist
self-host a gift registry with SSO login
let an AI assistant read my wishlists via MCP
how_to_run: Create a docker-compose.yml using the image ghcr.io/aunefyren/poenskelisten:latest with externalurl, dbtype: sqlite, and volumes for ./files/ and ./images/
Open the app on the external URL and register the first user, who becomes admin
Remove generateinvite after the first run
Alternatively, build from source with Go: go build, then ./poenskelisten
notable: Anonymous wish claiming: others see a wish is taken, the owner does not
Built-in OAuth 2.1 authorization server and read-only MCP endpoint for AI assistants
OIDC-only mode that disables password login, registration and reset
Server-side account recovery via resetpassword and resetmfa startup flags
Configurable via environment variables, startup flags or config.json
caveats: UI is not yet fully optimized for small screens
config.json holds secrets and signing keys that must be protected and kept on persistent storage
